Hi all — thanks Nora, good call on the evening window. Quick operational clarifications and the embedded evaluation plan (pulled from the attached checklist):

Operational runbook (short):
- Preflight (72–48 hours prior): environment validation, prefix cache warmers, baseline latency/throughput sweep. (Owner: Marissa)
- Canary start (Day 0 at 10pm PT): route 5% sessions, run scripted functional checks every 2 hours, collect token-level latency and failure rates. (Owner: Marissa)
- Canary ramp: if error rate <= 0.5% and avg token latency within +20% of baseline across 48h, move to 15% traffic. Otherwise pause and rollback. (Decision gate: joint ops call)
- Training & enablement: two sessions (Dec 2 & Dec 4):
  - Dec 2 - Ops & SRE (runbook, fallback, K/V cache ops)
  - Dec 4 - Support & CS (debugging, alert triage, acceptance criteria)

Evaluation plan highlights:
- Key metrics: token latency (p50/p95), generation error rate, hallucination spot-checks on 100 sampled prompts, cost delta per 1k tokens.
- Acceptance for full ramp: stable metrics for 72 hours at 50% traffic and successful training completion.

Attachments: updated MAP workbook v1 (tabbed by owner) and the evaluation checklist. Link to the live playbook in Drive included in the email headers.

Action items assigned now:
- Nora: confirm infra access for our smoke runners by 11/20
- Mike: confirm evening maintenance window and notification cadence
- Laura: send calendar invites for Dec 2 & Dec 4 training by EOD Thu
- Sergio: confirm internal escalation path for SLA exceptions

I'll ship the runbook (public link + PDF) and the canary automation playbook by 2pm PT today.

Thanks — Marissa
